[RARC.8.7.1] Synthetic identifiers (the synthetic names of [LLEX.10.6.1]) are
source-derived, not random. The runtime
must not take an identifier or a seed from an entropy
source or the wall clock, only from inputs that replay
reproduces. `event_id` is keyed on the run identifier,
the tier identifier and the `seq` of the fact's
`FactAssert` ([RARC.5.8.8]).
